audience: real estate agents and teams who manage leads and deals in Follow Up Boss

useCases.title: Get your daily brief
useCases.text: The AI lists today's appointments, the tasks due today, overdue tasks and new leads that nobody contacted yet, in your time zone.

useCases.title: See which agents have follow-ups waiting
useCases.text: The AI counts overdue tasks, tasks due today and uncontacted new leads for each agent, so a team leader sees who needs help.

useCases.title: Review new leads and where they came from
useCases.text: The AI searches people by criteria, reads lead events, and counts leads per lead source and agent with the conversion rate.

useCases.title: Book, move or cancel an appointment
useCases.text: The AI books a showing or listing appointment with the contact and agents, moves it, records the outcome or deletes it.

useCases.title: Tag, restage or reassign many contacts at once
useCases.text: The AI finds the contacts, then adds or removes tags, changes the stage, the agent or the pond for up to 100 contacts in one step.

useCases.title: Find, create, complete or reassign tasks
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks that are due today, overdue or upcoming, creates a task for a contact, and marks a task complete or reassigns it.
